goal: Validate three-asset execution and independent audit before any economic batch
expected: All 38 synthetic tests and exact causal intent binding pass
observed: One exact-intent failure and six downstream audit errors: 12.5 versus 12.500 in the same BTC quantity field
root_cause: Decimal integral division can retain a positive exponent. Multiplication by quantity step then emits fewer trailing zeros than the independently computed integer lot count. Values are exactly equal but the order intent has no canonical step-scale serialization.
next_action: Quantize the already lot-rounded requested quantity to its exact step exponent, retaining exact intent equality and the original test command for one retry

path_review.goal_alignment: Canonical execution intent is necessary to bind independent accounting; this does not optimize a strategy result
path_review.data_feasibility: S1 already verified 1056 new responses, complete three-asset minute grids and exact daily prices; no new download is needed
path_review.method_feasibility: Decimal quantize at the existing quantity step changes only text scale after floor rounding, not quantity, direction, costs, risk or audit acceptance
path_review.budget_and_exit: Within the accepted 10-hour implementation stage; no market attempts consumed. One original-command retry only; a second unresolved failure requires route reassessment
